+    if tag in _NUMERIC_BOUND_TAGS:
+        value = _float_param(issue.get("param"))
+        if value is None:
+            return None
+        direction, exclusive = _NUMERIC_BOUND_TAGS[tag]
+        return ObservationKind.NUMERIC_BOUND, NumericBoundPayload(
+            bound=value, direction=direction, exclusive=exclusive
+        )
+    if tag == "oneof":
+        param = issue.get("param")
+        if not isinstance(param, str) or not param.strip():
+            return None
+        return ObservationKind.ENUM, EnumPayload(values=tuple(param.split()))
+    return None
+
+
+def _text_observations(message: str, operation: APIOperation) -> tuple[Observation, ...]:
+    location = location_for_method(operation.method)
+    observations: list[Observation] = []
+    for match in _TEXT_CLAUSE.finditer(message):
+        result = _SELF_DESCRIBING.get(match.group("tag"))
+        if result is None:
+            continue
+        path = _build_path(match.group("namespace"))
+        if not path:
+            continue
+        kind, payload = result
+        observations.append(
+            Observation(
+                operation_label=operation.label,
+                location=location,
+                parameter_path=path,
+                kind=kind,
+                raw_message=match.group(0),
+                payload=payload,
+            )
+        )
+    return tuple(observations)
+
+
+def _structured_observations(issues: list, operation: APIOperation) -> tuple[Observation, ...]:
+    location = location_for_method(operation.method)
+    observations: list[Observation] = []
+    for issue in issues:
+        if not isinstance(issue, dict) or "kind" not in issue:
+            continue
+        tag = issue.get("tag")
+        namespace = issue.get("namespace")
+        if not isinstance(tag, str) or not isinstance(namespace, str) or not namespace:
+            continue
+        path = _build_path(namespace)
+        if not path:
+            continue
+        result = _classify_structured(tag, issue)
+        if result is None:
+            continue
+        kind, payload = result
+        raw_message = issue.get("message")
+        observations.append(
+            Observation(
+                operation_label=operation.label,
+                location=location,
+                parameter_path=path,
+                kind=kind,
+                raw_message=raw_message if isinstance(raw_message, str) else "",
+                payload=payload,
+            )
+        )
+    return tuple(observations)
+
+
+@PARSERS.register
+class GoValidatorParser:
+    """Parser for go-playground/validator envelopes — the default text form and the structured JSON list form."""
+
+    priority = 8
+
+    def can_parse(self, *, body: object) -> bool:
+        return _text_envelope(body) is not None or _structured_issues(body) is not None
+
+    def parse(self, *, operation: APIOperation, body: object) -> tuple[Observation, ...]:
+        message = _text_envelope(body)
+        if message is not None:
+            return _text_observations(message, operation)
+        issues = _structured_issues(body)
+        if issues is not None:
+            return _structured_observations(issues, operation)
+        return ()
+
+
